method: Exact Fast Spark detector/control simulation on user captures, with Spark makeup applied after the shared analyser as the v2.4 Gain Arbiter does. This estimates control magnitude only; it is not a rendered v2.4 browser capture.

architecture_assertions.shared_analyser_position: after Output and before AutoLevel/Gain Arbiter

interpretation: The bounded Spark envelope predicts roughly 0.17-0.19 dB RMS uplift, not the approximately 3.4 LUFS capture-to-capture difference previously observed. Moving makeup after the analyser prevents Auto Level from reacting against Spark and isolates capture/setup differences from the Spark detector itself.
unverified: A newly rendered v2.4 browser capture under matched playback, Windows volume, YouTube volume, preset and Auto Level state remains required for final audible/output verification.
